test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: Which option is incorrect for the component of time series?

options.text: Shifts in the level of a time series that cannot be explained are referred to as seasonal cycles
A trend is a gradual upward or downward shift in the level of the series
A sudden, temporary shift is referred as pulse
A non-seasonal cycle is a repetitive, possibly unpredictable, pattern in the series values

solution:
The correct option is **Shifts in the level of a time series that cannot be explained are referred to as seasonal cycles. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When a time series is impacted by seasonal elements like the season or day of the week, a seasonal pattern develops. Seasonality always has a set and recognizable periodicity. The seasonality in the monthly sales of anti-diabetic medications seen above is caused in part by a change in the price of the medications at the end of the year.
 
• The act of estimating and then eliminating systematic and calendar-related influences from a time series is known as seasonal adjustment. Observed data must be seasonally adjusted because seasonal influences might mask both the series' true underlying movement and some non-seasonal traits that analysts may find interesting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Although they are commonly mistaken, seasonal and cyclical behaviour is extremely different. If there is no definite frequency for the fluctuations, they are cyclical; if there is a fixed frequency that is seasonal and linked to a certain aspect of the calendar.
 
• The average length of a cycle is often longer than the average length of a seasonal pattern, and the magnitudes of cycles are typically more variable than those of seasonal patterns.
 
• Many time series include trends, cycles, and seasonality. We must first identify the time series patterns__ present in the data before selecting a forecasting approach that can accurately capture the patterns.

Hence in the level of a time series that cannot be explained are referred to as seasonal cycles **are not true in the case of time series.**
